architecture: Cache paragraph-local measured lines and sparse adjustments. Fragment publication reads current tokens and executes current image/atomic/table/absolute-anchor work. Immutable shared text uses a non-owning descriptor guarded by source/run identity, shaping generation, first-line style selection and composition inputs; dynamic control/replaced tokens and metrics are retained exactly.
dependencies: Container/run identity, available width, percentage-height basis, paragraph alignment/indent, composition/hyphenation/sentence policies, overflow, pseudo heights, shaping resource generation and first-line style ranges, exact dynamic inputs, and float exclusion bands relative to the paragraph. Ended float bands are irrelevant; float wrapping mode remains explicit. Intrinsic measurement and published layout use separate cache slots.
ownership_and_budget: The executor owns measured results in recycled scratch; snapshots do not clone them. Keep current base/refined inputs, with separate intrinsic/published slots and no resize history. Immutable text descriptors own no token arrays, including temporary policy plans. Dynamic arrays and all local line payloads count toward the 4 MiB result budget plus reported slot metadata.
regressions_covered: Image height moves unchanged paragraphs without recomposition
Whole float context translation versus changed exclusion height
Inline images, atomic inline tables, percentage table cells, first-line and first-letter refinements, generated content, tabs, overflow ellipsis and composition/width switches match uncached results
Intrinsic probes preserve the cell paragraph result used for publication
Large chapter retention remains bounded across width changes
Temporary shared policy token arrays are released when the operation ends; paragraph metadata does not pin unaccounted buffers
Prepared token-plan keys distinguish book and sentence modes; policy transitions match fresh shaping/layout
benchmark_scene: Real c1/c2/c3 chapters. Image cases probe actual chapter image-file headers outside timing, seed all intrinsic metrics, then alternate one existing figure height by 80 pixels at unchanged width. Cold/resize cases retain the previous harness scene with initially unknown image dimensions. Web-compatible and book composition are measured separately.
measurement_scope: Deterministic mock font backend; native fonts/GPU/image pixel decoding and full application latency are excluded. CPU time uses CLOCK_PROCESS_CPUTIME_ID; user instructions use gated Linux perf counters; separate allocator tracking records requested live/peak heap; uninstrumented process getrusage records RSS. Decimal MB.

method.source: identical harness source in frozen and development worktrees

tradeoff: Image updates use about 35.6-39.1% fewer user instructions across these chapters. Retained heap rises about 0.64-1.54 MB. Changed-width layout still recomposes and cold-load/resize wall and CPU timing can regress modestly; full raw and paired data are retained. Shared-machine scheduling/clock variation remains.
parity: All 18 timing and heap cases match glyph/line counts, complete render geometry/paint, effective text colors and source correspondence.
baseline_exceptions: Preexisting style-model size/niche assertion filtered out
External WPT integration needs unavailable HTML_WPT_ROOT; self-contained workspace library and reading tests passed
